skills.name: Writing about cultural diversity and tolerance

note.text:
Cultural diversity means many different cultures living side by side: languages, religions, foods, dances, dress and festivals. Cameroon has more than two hundred ethnic groups, two official languages (English and French) and many religions.
Tolerance means accepting people whose ideas, beliefs or customs are different from ours, and treating them with respect.
Writing a short composition:
• Introduction: say what cultural diversity is.
• Body: give examples, then explain why tolerance matters (peace, friendship, learning from each other).
• Conclusion: say what we can do (learn a greeting in another language, share food, invite friends to our festivals).
Use linking words: for example, also, however, because, so, in conclusion.

worked_example.problem: Plan three short paragraphs on cultural diversity in {t}.
steps: Introduction: In {t} there are pupils from many tribes, who speak different languages and follow different religions.
Body: For example, we eat achu, ndolé and koki at the school fair. Tolerance matters because it keeps us friends.
Conclusion: In conclusion, we should learn from each other, for example by learning greetings in other languages.
worked_example.answer: Introduction (what diversity is) → body (examples and why tolerance matters) → conclusion (what we can do).

cards.idea: Cultural diversity means many cultures together; tolerance means accepting and respecting differences.
example: Diversity: many languages, foods and festivals.
Tolerance: I respect my friend's religion even if it is not mine.

pick.r: I respect my friend's religion, even though it is not mine.
w: My language is the only good one.
I laugh at people who dress differently.
I don't eat with people from other tribes.
e: Laughing at differences is not tolerance.
pick.y: Respecting a different religion is tolerance.

pick.r: Our class has pupils who speak eight different languages.
w: Everybody in our town is the same.
We all eat the same food every day.
pick.y: Many languages in one class is cultural diversity.

pick.q: Which is a good way to show tolerance?
pick.r: Learn a greeting in a classmate's language.
e: That does not respect their beliefs.

cards.idea: A composition has an introduction, a body and a conclusion.
example: Body: examples and reasons. Conclusion: what we should do.

cards.idea: Linking words join ideas: for example, also, however, because, so, in conclusion.
example: We eat different foods, for example achu and ndolé.
In conclusion, tolerance keeps the peace.

questions.prompt: Put the parts of the composition in order.

items.text: Cameroon has many cultures, languages and religions
For example, in my class we speak Bakweri, Bamileke, Fulfulde and Pidgin
Tolerance is important because it helps us live in peace
In conclusion, we should respect and learn from each other

pick.s: We have many festivals, ___ the Ngondo and the Nguon.
e: The festivals that follow are examples.

pick.s: Our languages are different; ___, we understand each other in English.
e: The idea is a contrast: however.
The idea is a contrast, not a reason.

pick.s: We respect each other ___ we want to live in peace.
e: A reason follows, not an example.
Because needs a reason after it.

questions.prompt: Choose the linking word that fits.

paper_task.prompt: Write a short composition of three paragraphs (about one hundred and twenty words) on the topic “Cultural diversity and tolerance in my community”. Use an introduction, a body with examples, and a conclusion, and at least three linking words.
model: My community is like a small Cameroon. People from many tribes live here: Bakweri, Bamileke, Bassa, Fulani and others. We speak different languages and follow different religions.

For example, at the end of the year our school holds a cultural day. Pupils wear their traditional dress, sing and share food such as achu, ndolé and kilishi. Tolerance is important because it helps us to live in peace. However, some people still laugh at other people's accents, and this hurts.
In conclusion, diversity makes us rich. We should respect each other's beliefs, learn new greetings and invite our friends to our festivals.
checklist: My composition has three paragraphs: introduction, body, conclusion.
I explained what cultural diversity is.
I gave at least two examples from my community.
I used at least three linking words.
I did not insult or make fun of any group.
I checked my spelling and punctuation.
